span.p:
1 Frame
- Read trigger
- Restate problem
- Out-of-scope items
- Risk tier
- Repro (if investigation)

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
2 Design
- RFC (Medium+; skip for Critical incidents)
- ADR (architectural)
- Shape + critique (UI only)
- Test plan

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
3 Implement
- Vertical slices
- Docs alongside code

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
4 Verify
- make pc
- Manual exercise
- Determinism check (new E2E/integration)

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
5 Document
- Touch-map
- Archive RFC/ADR (promote drafts)
- Postmortem (if Critical or incident)

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
6 Handoff
- Self-review
- Draft PR + agent-in-progress label
- Bot-PR contract
- Merge + verify Jira Done
- Close tracking tasks
